title: AI Tutor — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Explains difficult subjects in simple terms, adapting to the student's questions. The AI Tutor explains difficult subjects in simple, plain language. It breaks hard topics into small steps, answers follow-up questions, checks understanding with quick questions of its own, and adjusts its explanations to the student's level. Every explanation cites the course material it is based on so the student can verify it.
capabilities: Explain any course topic in plain step-by-step language
Answer follow-up questions and clarify confusion
Check understanding with quick practice questions
Adapt explanation depth to the student's level
Cite the course material behind each explanation
